newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Chase says on target for 19 pct ROE. [CORRECTED 17:54 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chase says on target for 19 pct ROE. [CORRECTED 17:54 GMT]

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp chairman and chief executive Walter Shipley said his bank was on track to achieve 1997 targeted growth of 19 percent return on equity and double digit growth in earnings per share.
In an interview with Reuters Financial Television, Shipley said he also expected the bank to achieve its aim of six to eight percent revenue growth. (Corrects from "16 percent revenue growth")
"We are holding to our targets this year of double digit growth in earnings per share and 19 per cent return on equity. We are on path to achieve that," he said.
